instructions:
Inspired by iPadOS's StageManager

Press SPACE to create window
Drag the three dots to move window
Drag the icon on bottom right to resize window

Beta testing version (For FutureOS)
Please offer suggestions if you have any

The edge of the screen has some render issues which makes it not aligned(WebKit compatibility issues, only identified on Safari)
